mods.name: Agent Backend Doctor
mods.description: Finds, un-caches and repairs KiroCrew's agent-backend harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, pi). Fills the host's adapter search when an npm global prefix it does not look in (~/.local/node, ~/.npm-global, a ~/.npmrc prefix, $NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX) holds claude-agent-acp / codex-acp / pi-acp; resets the gateway's cached 'not found' so a backend installed after the gateway started works without a restart; keeps a Bedrock-backed Codex's AWS credentials usable inside KiroCrew's sandbox (an isolated 0600 copy of the configured profile's non-secret keys outside ~/.aws, handed to the codex-acp child explicitly, with a launch preflight and a sandboxed provider-chain probe); one page showing per backend what the host sees, what this mod found, the gateway cache state and the advertised models, with an opt-in CODEX_PATH switch (run the codex you installed) and an opt-in symlink repair into ~/.local/bin. Exposes a readiness read for other mods (installed, cache state, Codex preflight) so a session is only moved to a backend that will start. Unofficial.

mods.name: Agent Orchestrator
mods.description: Real parallel multi-agent orchestration for KiroCrew: an orchestrator session divides a goal into items, runs one worker session per item at the same time, and coordinates them live over a typed, bounded message bus (hub-and-spoke: every worker reports to the orchestrator, which relays; worker ⇄ worker is an opt-in setting) with wake-ups, a wait-any primitive and per-worker status lines. Ships the `agent-orchestrator` and `agent-orchestrator-worker` agents (built on the host's session-control and work-ledger tools, which stay untouched) and a live hub-and-spoke graph page with an animated message bus. Unofficial.

mods.name: Custom themes
mods.description: A theme editor for KiroCrew inside the FloofyCrew App, and the layer theme mods build on. A theme is a host theme pack (palette, branding, fonts, overrides.css — installed through the host's own validator, listed in Settings → Display) plus a FloofyCrew layer of extra CSS that may restyle anything, scoped to the theme and applied by the mod on the first frame and at runtime. Start from the running host's own built-in themes (read from its stylesheet, decorations included), edit every palette token with a live preview, export/import a theme as one file, install it and switch to it. Carries the theme-reset guard every custom theme needs. Unofficial.

mods.name: Display comfort
mods.description: Persistent chat text size and an arbitrary page zoom for the KiroCrew dashboard. A settings page with two sliders: chat text scale (50–250 %, applied to every message bubble, optionally the composer too) and page zoom (25–300 % in 1 % steps, any value — not just the browser's fixed stops). Both persist in the mod's config, apply live as you drag, and are restored before the first paint on the next load so nothing flashes at the default size. Answers the upstream quality-of-life requests for a chat font-size control and a free-form zoom value. Unofficial.

mods.name: Kiro Spec & Plan
mods.description: Adds Kiro's built-in modes to the agent list — Spec, Quick Spec, Bug Fix and Plan — the same structured workflows as Kiro IDE, run by the kiro-cli v3 engine (KAS). Needs agent.acp_backend = kas.

mods.name: Model Retry Policy
mods.description: Chooses what KiroCrew does when the model or its API fails transiently (throttling, overload, 5xx, dropped stream) instead of the fixed three retries: a retry count of your own, retry forever at a fixed interval, retry forever with exponential backoff, or a fallback profile that moves to other models after N retries (and optionally never gives up on the last). Applies to dashboard chats (including errors that land mid-turn, after text or a tool call has streamed), cron/Slack turns and sub-agents. Opt-in backend failover: when a dashboard chat's same-model retries are spent, the chat is moved to another agent backend that serves the SAME model (kiro-cli, KAS, Claude Code, Codex — as Agent Backend Router's served lists allow and Agent Backend Doctor confirms the backend is usable), the conversation replayed by KiroCrew's own provider-switch replay; the model never changes. Unofficial.

agent-backend-doctor.reason: answers whether a failover target is usable right now (installed, its cached 'not found' cleared, a Bedrock-backed Codex's credential chain intact) before a throttled chat is moved there

mods.name: OS notification bridge
mods.description: Mirrors KiroCrew's in-app notifications to native OS banners: approval waits, cron reports, skill reviews and the rest of the feed reach the desktop even when the dashboard is in the background. Listens to the host's own notification fan-out (channel mutes keep their meaning), enriches banners from the feed API (title, body, deep link), and adds the settings surface the platform needs: a real permission button, a background-only policy, one switch per kind, and the host's hidden turn-complete flag surfaced as a switch. Unofficial; not part of KiroCrew.

mods.name: Settings demo
mods.description: The example of a mod with its own settings page inside the FloofyCrew App (Requirement 16.4): a text field and a toggle persisted through floofy.mod(id).config, and a button calling the mod's own backend route, which the python-hook part registers with ctx.routes and which echoes the stored config. Unofficial; the second first-party mod.
